application_steps.value: Apply electronically through IBB Business Team before starting eligible measures; review signature and submission requirements in the guideline.

founder_scenario.value: An unincorporated Berlin-based AI software founder cannot treat intent to form as completed establishment. Complete eligible establishment before application, meet the Berlin/18-month conditions and verify remaining requirements. Overall eligibility remains UNKNOWN. No fixed deadline is verified.

funding.value: Grant covering 50% of eligible expenditure, capped at EUR 50,000; costs must satisfy the guideline.

geography.value: Headquarters in Berlin and completed establishment required at application; age no more than 18 months.

obligations.value: Conditionally repayable, purpose-bound project grant, paid as partial financing. This is not an unconditional non-repayable award.

software_ai.value: Digital/technological business models are listed; AI relevance does not itself establish eligibility.

source_review.value: Official page accessible; every previously cited page quotation was still present at 2026-10-23T09:48:15.012153+00:00. Full-page hash changed. Full eligibility and possible uncited term changes still require review.

unincorporated.value: Establishment must already be completed at application; not eligible merely on intent to form.

conditions.milestone: Complete eligible establishment and verify all other prerequisites

conditions.description: No more than 18 months old at application
